To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the angular resolution of a radar imaging system can be improved by means of a two-dimensional antenna array, which is composed of a linear antenna arrangement on the transmit and an orthogonal linear antenna arrangement on receiver side.
the angular resolution capability of a MIMO radar imaging system is significantly influenced by the antenna array configuration.
the proposed antenna arrays provide better angular resolution than a full planar array, while allowing for the use of less than 1/3 of the antennas.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a new radar imaging system, which uses only a small number of antennas on both transmit and receive sides and which provides high angular resolution.
the investigation of the angular resolution capability of 2-D antenna array configurations for MIMO radar applications.
the development of new antenna geometries for 2-D MIMO radar imaging.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the angular resolution is better than that of a full planar array, but the resolution is worse than that of a radar with a single transmit antenna and a full receive array.
the inverted T-shaped antenna array provides the best performance in terms of angular resolution.

a 1D-antenna array with a 2D beamforming approach provides better angular resolution than a 2D-array with a 3D beamforming approach, but the latter provides better angular resolution and less sidelobe levels.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a highly efficient antenna arrangement is presented, allowing for a highly accurate angular resolution.
the proposed geometries provide the same angular resolution as the full planar array with a reduced number of antennas.
the angular resolution capability of MIMO radar imaging is significantly improved by the presented antenna arrays.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the angular resolution capability can be improved by a factor of up to 2.5 compared to the full planer antenna array, while reducing the number of antenna elements to only one third of the full planar array.
for 2D imaging applications, a 1D array on transmit and a 2D array on receive side provides a better angular resolution than a 2D antenna array in both directions.

the angular resolution is not only determined by the antenna array configuration but also by the number of transmit and receive antenna elements, the transmit signal bandwidth and the number of processed samples.
